subject: Your tax refund is ready - claim within 24 hours

message.subject: Your tax refund is ready - claim within 24 hours
message.excerpt: You are eligible for a refund. Claim it within 24 hours or it will be forfeited: https://irs-refund-claim.example/start

findings.title: A link points at a lookalike domain
evidence: Link to irs-refund-claim[.]example wraps the name from irs[.]gov in extra words (imitating IRS)
findings.lesson: Hover before you click. The link's domain, not its text, tells you where you'll land.

findings.title: Sender failed DMARC
evidence: DMARC failed for irs[.]gov (domain policy: reject)
findings.lesson: A failed sender check means the message may be forged. If it claims to be from someone you know, confirm with them another way.

findings.title: SPF or DKIM check failed
evidence: SPF did not pass for irs[.]gov
findings.lesson: Real mail from a company is signed. Failed signatures are one more reason to slow down.

indicators.reason: domain used in a phishing link
